name: fleet-orchestration
description: Run many Claude Code sessions on one codebase without them lying to each other — and faster. A zero-dependency CLI turns the protocol into eleven one-command rituals (validated heartbeats, census, the waiter's blocker check, typename-aware run-grouped PR checks, stale-verdict sweep, post-merge unblocks, jobs-not-runs CI load, digests), each with its evidence rule built in. Plus the protocol skill, the evidence rules that survived a 38-merge multi-repo run, a staleness monitor that reads a lane's artifact before calling it silent, and descending-model role definitions.

context.title: Fleet Orchestration
context.summary: Protocol, evidence rules, heartbeat monitor and descending-model role definitions for running many Claude Code sessions on one codebase. Repo list, lane names and paths are configuration, not hardcoded.
